questions.question: What is S-NODE's answer: exact minimum Node version with node:sqlite and timeout and no flag?
questions.why: ADR-0002 and the CI matrix (§6.6) both need this number before M0 can pick a runtime target.

questions.question: Is context.db created at MCP initialize, at first tool call, or at install time?
questions.why: GP1 checks project read right after initialize; M0 code must know the exact open point.

questions.question: What is the exact PreToolUse rewrite rule set for 'flood-prone commands', beyond curl/wget examples?
questions.why: ADR-0008 names PreToolUse rewriting but M0 needs a full, closed list, since no regex/truncation may be used as the decision logic itself.

questions.question: What are the 7 tool names and 7 schemas exactly, since §1 GS5 says 'tools/list (7 tools)' but §10 Q12 lists 9 ctx_ names?
questions.why: PRD §16 says 9 tools (ctx_execute, ctx_batch, ctx_index, ctx_search, ctx_resume, ctx_stats, ctx_doctor, ctx_upgrade, ctx_purge); TECH-SPEC GP2 says 7. This is a direct conflict to resolve before coding any tool list.

questions.question: When PostToolUse caps oversized output, what is the exact byte cap number, and is it per tool or global?
questions.why: ADR-0016 says large output must never enter any subagent context; M0 needs the literal cap value to code the wrapper.

questions.question: What is the exact ctx_resume compaction format inside the 2 KB cap: which fields, in what order?
questions.why: §3 (ADR-0009) sets a 2 KB ceiling but GP6 checks against a golden file; M0 needs the schema to write that golden file.

questions.question: For GS9 (stateless server/discover vs initialize at two MCP versions), is this one code path with a version switch, or two server builds?
questions.why: This changes the whole server bootstrap structure for M0, so it must be fixed first, not refactored later.

questions.question: What counts as a 'v1 leftover' for ctx_doctor to detect, as a literal list of paths and config keys?
questions.why: GP11 golden-tests the doctor table; without the literal list M0 cannot write a correct detector or its test fixture.

questions.question: Is the single context.db per project locked with WAL mode, and what happens on GP8's '0 busy errors' when 4 servers write at once?
questions.why: G21/ADR-0002 picks one db per project but the concurrency mechanism (WAL vs mutex vs queue) is not stated, and M0's db layer depends on it.

questions.question: Does 'no fallback chains' (owner decision) forbid try/catch retry logic entirely, or only forbid silently falling back to a different data source on error?
questions.why: M0's db and sandbox code need error handling; the no-fallback-chain rule must be scoped exactly or every try/catch risks violating it.

questions.question: Is the hard-deny-with-v1-scope rule (ADR-0008 r3) a fixed deny list shipped in v2, or is it generated fresh from v1's issue history at build time?
questions.why: M0 needs to know whether to hand-write the deny list now or build a generator script instead.

questions.question: What is the exact git tag and branch flow for the first v2 release: does 'release' branch get its own tag, separate from 'v*-rc*' tags used for live E2E?
questions.why: §6.9 only defines rc tags; M0 needs to know if a plain v2.0.0 tag is also required and who cuts it.

questions.question: Since skills are removed from the repo (Q4/Q4b) but /ctx-stats, /ctx-doctor, /ctx-upgrade are shipped as skills (Q3), where do these three skill files live if not under .claude/skills/context-mode-ops?
questions.why: This is an apparent contradiction in the current docs that blocks laying out the M0 repo tree (§4).

questions.question: What exact debug fields must an AI agent include in a bug issue for it to be accepted, per the 'maximum debug data' rule?
questions.why: The issue intake template is for AI agents only and must be written before M0 issue triage can start; the field list is not in any doc yet.

questions.question: Is 'main frozen' enforced only by convention, or does M0 need a branch-protection rule or CI check that blocks direct pushes to main?
questions.why: If no automated check exists, a single accidental merge breaks the v1 freeze this PRD depends on.
